Mahindra Launches New XUV 3XO Variants with Sunroof Under ₹10 Lakh

Mahindra has launched two new variants of its XUV 3XO model: the REVX Edge and the EDGE (O). These variants are priced below ₹10 lakh and feature a panoramic sunroof. The REVX Edge variant is specifically highlighted for offering this feature at a price point starting from ₹9.89 lakh.
